**Company:** Kirana Everbright Packaging Sdn. Bhd. (Private limited company) was incorporated on 26 Nov 2005 in Sarawak, Malaysia. The company is currently active and operates in the manufacturing industry, specialising in the production of plastic packaging for food products. Its share capital is RM2.5 m.  

**Director & Shareholder:** The board comprises 4 directors. The company has 1 shareholder, Sejahtera Holdings Sdn. Bhd., holding 100.00 % of the shares.  

**Financials:** In FY 2024 revenue fell by 20.3 % from RM30.35 m to RM24.21 m, with a gross profit margin of 23.3 % and an operating profit margin of 2.3 %. Free cash flow was RM101.48 k, while net debt stood at RM1.59 m (borrowings RM3.65 m minus cash RM2.05 m). The firm shows declining top‑line growth and thin operating profitability, yet it remains cash‑generating and has modest net debt.  

**Litigation:** No court cases were recorded.  

**Review Rating:** 4/5 – High review priority: revenue decline and low operating margin are notable concerns, but the company remains cash‑positive and has no defendant litigation to offset the risks.
